attempt.title: proposals for increasing annual leave and improving childcare policies
attempt.what_it_is: proposals for increasing annual leave and improving childcare policies
attempt.why_it_matters: The record highlights the need for breathing space and quality time for young people and families, which will impact their well-being and relationships.
not_said: How can neighbourly childminding be implemented and regulated?
What is the timeline for normalising neighbourly childminding in Singapore?

key_points.point: The Government should increase the minimum annual leave to provide breathing space for young people to socialise and date, and for people to spend quality time with their families.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Let us structurally mandate breathing space for our young people to socialise and date, and for people to spend quality time with their families.

citations.text: Let us structurally mandate breathing space for our young people to socialise and date, and for people to spend quality time with their families.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: Seven days of annual leave is really too short.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: With the ongoing review of the Employment Act, now is the time to increase the minimum annual leave.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

key_points.point: The Government should provide a limited subsidy to underutilised childcare centres to fund shuttle services and improve spatial mobility.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: To address this spatial mismatch, we could provide a limited subsidy to such underutilised operators to fund shuttle services, regardless of whether they are MK, AOP or POP, much like the school bus system our primary school children enjoy.

citations.text: To address this spatial mismatch, we could provide a limited subsidy to such underutilised operators to fund shuttle services, regardless of whether they are MK, AOP or POP, much like the school bus system our primary school children enjoy.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: This helps reduce geographic friction, improves spatial mobility and achieves better allocative efficiency for childcare services.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

key_points.point: Singapore should normalise neighbourly childminding to support parents, especially those without grandparent or domestic help.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: In Bishan, some playground mummies organise playdates and take turns to look after one another's children.

citations.text: In Bishan, some playground mummies organise playdates and take turns to look after one another's children.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: How can we facilitate more of these and build a stronger communal parenting culture?
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: We can suggest guidelines for the respective families to adopt in such informal childminding in the neighbourhood.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: As I have previously raised in this House, I propose comprehensive home visitation postpartum support.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: Trained maternity nurses could provide guidance on newborn care, breastfeeding, physiotherapy and mental health screening.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

citations.text: They could also identify signs of family stress, social isolation or financial difficulty, and coordinate follow-up support with health and social services so families can receive timely counselling and financial assistance.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

key_points.point: The Government should introduce a Career Comeback Tax Credit for employers who hire returning stay-at-home parents.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: In this Career Comeback Scheme, companies that hire stay-at-home parent returnees may qualify for a tax deduction on the employee's salary for up to 12 months.

citations.text: In this Career Comeback Scheme, companies that hire stay-at-home parent returnees may qualify for a tax deduction on the employee's salary for up to 12 months.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

key_points.point: Employers should be incentivised to provide flexibility in work schedules and private spaces for mothers to pump breast milk at work.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Third, we should incentivise and encourage employers to provide flexibility in work schedules and private spaces for mothers to pump breast milk at work.

key_points.point: The Government should consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing (EEF) to help women who are marrying later in life still have a chance at having a child.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Fourth, to help women who are marrying later in life still have a chance at having a child, the Government should consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing (EEF) or allowing MediSave to be used for it.

citations.text: Fourth, to help women who are marrying later in life still have a chance at having a child, the Government should consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing (EEF) or allowing MediSave to be used for it.

key_points.point: Housing policies should proactively encourage larger and inter-generational families.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Our housing policies must proactively encourage larger and inter-generational families.

citations.text: Our housing policies must proactively encourage larger and inter-generational families.

key_points.point: Families with two or more young children should be given priority and expanded options to ballot and receive additional grants for 5-room or larger units.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Additionally, families with two or more young children should be given priority and expanded options to ballot and receive additional grants for 5-room or larger units across BTO and Sales of Balance Flats.

citations.text: Additionally, families with two or more young children should be given priority and expanded options to ballot and receive additional grants for 5-room or larger units across BTO and Sales of Balance Flats.

key_points.point: The Government should make a wholly different and wholesome kind of commitment, so people feel secure raising a family in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I am asking the Government to make a wholly different and wholesome kind of commitment, so people feel secure raising a family in Singapore.

citations.text: I am asking the Government to make a wholly different and wholesome kind of commitment, so people feel secure raising a family in Singapore.

key_points.point: The Government should build a society that views parenthood as valuable, beautiful, joyful and not a high stakes competition.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: So that our society will view parenthood as valuable, beautiful, joyful and not a high stakes competition, so that everyone will play their part in supporting families to flourish.

citations.text: So that our society will view parenthood as valuable, beautiful, joyful and not a high stakes competition, so that everyone will play their part in supporting families to flourish.
citations.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)

key_points.point: The government is developing a long-term roadmap to strengthen support for marriage and parenthood, mobilise whole-of-society action and support a broader societal reset.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Hence, the Workgroup’s focus is to see how we can better support Singaporeans across the whole marriage and parenthood journey.
